name: Birthplace of Jesus: Church of the Nativity and the Pilgrimage Route, Bethlehem
description: In Bethlehem, about 10 km south of Jerusalem, this church stands over the grotto traditionally revered as the birthplace of Jesus. The first church was completed in 339, and its 6th-century replacement still has patches of the original mosaic floor beneath it. Around it cluster Latin, Greek Orthodox, Armenian and Franciscan convents, terraced gardens and the pilgrim route leading in.
